title: Jagged Vegan Flan
description: A rich and creamy vegan flan recipe made with jagged, peppery, and mexican flavors.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the cooked jagged rice, ground peppercorns, and flan mix.
Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in the coconut cream, agave nectar, lime juice, and vanilla extract.
Pour the mixture into 6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 45-50 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are slightly jiggly.
Remove from the water bath and let cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until chilled.
Serve the jagged vegan flan cold, garnished with a sprinkle of ground peppercorns if desired.
